name: Lytone Enterprise, Inc.
summary: Lytone Enterprise, Inc., established in 1994 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the research and development of functional food items alongside agricultural and livestock industry provisions. The company delivers comprehensive post-harvest treatments for various fresh produce, including mangoes, guavas, apples, kiwi fruits, avocados, citrus varieties, and tomatoes, extending these services to the floriculture sector as well. In the functional food arena, Lytone develops sophisticated ingredients and formulations designed to support anti-aging, protect the nervous system, boost physical vitality, help regulate blood sugar, and enhance skin health. Their offerings also include probiotics and prebiotics. For the agricultural and animal husbandry industries, they provide specialized agents, performance-enhancing fertilizers, and feed additives. Serving a diverse client base of growers, packaging facilities, and retail businesses, Lytone Enterprise, Inc. maintains a significant international presence. Its operations span China, Japan, Korea, Southeast Asia, Europe, the United States, Oceania, the Middle East, and East Africa.
